name: gowords
description: Go words: a registry of resumable workstreams with due dates and not_before times, listed by /gowords:go.

timezone.title: Time zone
timezone.description: IANA time zone for dates and delays, for example Europe/Paris. Empty means the system time zone.

language.title: Output language
language.description: Language of tables and alerts: en or fr.

stale_days.title: Stale after (days)
stale_days.description: An open workstream with no due date is flagged when its file has not changed for this many days.

memory_dir.title: Workstream directory
memory_dir.description: Directory that holds the workstream files. Empty means the automatic memory directory of the current project.

session_alert.title: Session start alert
session_alert.description: on shows workstreams due within 48 hours when a session starts; off disables the alert.

peers.title: Ask neighbouring sessions
peers.description: ask lists the running sessions and waits for your yes before messaging them; on messages them without asking; off skips that step.
